ronald-acuna-jr.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.

current_injury.details: Suffered a non-displaced fracture of the left fibula during Spring Training 2026. Missed virtually the entire 2025 season and into early 2026. On the 60-day injured list while rehabbing. This is his first injury-shortened season since 2023.

injury_history.details: Non-displaced fracture sustained in Spring Training 2026. Currently on 60-day IL rehabbing.
Strained the medial collateral ligament in his left knee during a game. Missed time but returned.
Torn meniscus requiring surgery. Faced long-term concerns about his clutch-play dominance returning.
Bone bruise and contusion to the left knee. Missed time but recovered.

ronald-acuna-jr.notes: First injury-shortened season since 2023. Acuña's return timeline is still uncertain. Community contributors should monitor Braves beat reporters (Journal Sentinel, MLB.com) for Rehab Gate updates. The fibula fracture adds to a well-documented history of knee issues.

mookie-betts.name: Mookie Betts

current_injury.details: Strained right oblique. Was 'symptom-free' as of mid-April 2026 per Dave Roberts, but will NOT be activated when eligible. Betts hit .179/.281/.429 across eight games before the injury. Dodgers are hopeful he can return sooner than expected, but there is no specific return date. Oblique injuries often require 3-4+ weeks absence.
current_injury.rehab_timeline: No specific timeline. Not activated even when symptomatic-free.

injury_history.details: Strained right oblique. Symptom-free but NOT being activated when eligible. Manager Dave Roberts confirmed this cautious approach. Hit .179 in 8 games before injury. New roster added but prolonged absence expected.
injury_history.return_status: On IL - No activation date set

injury_history.details: Stiff lower back causing consecutive game misses. Out 3+ games as of July 13,BETD NOT expected to be placed on IL. Manager Dave Roberts: 'He's feeling a little better.'
Broken right wrist during batting practice in a freak spring training accident at Camelback Ranch. Struck by a deflected ball from a pitching machine. Sidelined 6-8 weeks.
Strain caused lineup removal and a stint on the injured list. Dave Roberts gave optimistic update as treatment improved symptoms. Betts returned to the lineup.
Severe illness causing significant weight loss (nearly 20 lbs in two weeks). Added death of stepfather to a difficult stretch.

rehab_timeline.notes: Conservative treatment. Not activated even when symptom-free. Oblique injuries often require 1+ month absence.

mookie-betts.return_status: On IL - Symptom-free but no activation date. Recurring oblique issue.
mookie-betts.notes: Betts' 2025-2026 has been tumultuous — broken wrist, oblique strain (x2), severe illness, personal loss, and back issues. All major injuries have resolved but the right oblique has returned. Community should update if recurring back or oblique issues worsen or if any future complications arise.

freddie-freeman.name: Freddie Freeman

current_injury.details: Freeman was scratched from the lineup on August 27, 2025 due to a neck stinger that went from his neck into his right shoulder. He returned to the lineup on Friday but experienced lingering effects. Manager Dave Roberts: 'He feels a lot better. There's still some kind of lingering effects, but nothing compromising. It is something that we'll keep an eye on day-to-day, but I feel confident that he can get through it and won't have any setbacks.' Freeman is NOT expected to miss games, and the Dodgers have an off day coming up to help manage this. Chronic left ankle sprain from June 2025 is being managed with treatment and load management. Right ankle debridement (Dec 2024) history continues.
current_injury.severity: Mild (neck stinger - resolved); Moderate (chronic ankle - managed)
current_injury.rehab_timeline: No active rehab. Chronic ankle managed with load management and occasional treatment.

injury_history.details: Late scratch from lineup vs. Cincinnati Reds. Stinger went from neck into right shoulder. Returned Friday with lingering effects still monitored day-to-day by Roberts. Not expected to miss games.
Sprained left ankle. Managed with treatment and load management. Not a full absence from lineup.
Ongoing neck management reported by Dodgers coaching staff after August stinger.

Sprained right ankle late in regular season. Underwent debridement and removal of loose bodies in early December 2024. Played through injury in 2024 postseason including World Series walk-off grand slam.

rehab_timeline.notes: No active rehab. Chronic ankle managed with load management and occasional treatment. Off day on Monday expected to help manage neck stinger effects.

freddie-freeman.return_status: N/A - Currently active and playing regularly. Neck stinger resolved, chronic ankle under management.
freddie-freeman.notes: Freeman's chronic ankle issues (both right and left) require ongoing monitoring, especially as a first baseman placing heavy stress on lower extremities. Previous left ankle sprain in June 2025 and right ankle debridement in Dec 2024 suggest a trend. The 2025 neck stinger was minor but may recur. Freeman's walk-off Grand Slam in the 2024 World Series cemented his legend despite injury challenges. Community should track Dodgers beat reporters for any lineup changes.
